# `attribute`

A number with a base and a stack of modifiers.

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `seat` (one of `"body"`, `"mind"` ([`Seat`](#seat)); optional): Whether it stays with the body or leaves with the mind.
- `base` ([expression of number](../values.md#expressions); optional): The value before modifiers: a literal, or an expression about the owner (`self`), which makes the attribute derived. Zero if left out.
- `min` (number, or `null`; optional): The least the value can be, after modifiers.
- `max` (number, or `null`; optional): The most the value can be, after modifiers.

<a id="seat"></a>
### `Seat`

Which goes where when a mind and a body part company (06 §8.2).

One of:

- `"body"`: Stays with the body.
- `"mind"`: Leaves with the mind.
